Software Engineer in Test - Mossgate Software

About the role
Mossgate builds scheduling software and is growing its quality engineering group. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build automated test suites
- Improve CI feedback times
- Work with developers on testability

Requirements
- Test automation with Selenium or Playwright
- Python
- CI/CD pipelines
- API testing
- Performance testing

Nice to have
- Cypress

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
